author: codex-root-checkpoint-19
reason: Issue #1 requires an integrated durable intent, clarification, evaluation, diagnosis and reconciliation protocol; existing components do not fully specify that composition.

before.exactText: Given contradictions, ambiguous acceptance or missing critical control, critic findings identify repair and advancement blocks until resolved.

after.proposal: Add the source-mapped CL-001–018 integration overlay, 24 obligations, four supplementary cases and strict draft payload schemas. Preserve original task/criterion semantics and CP/WF authority. See CLOSED-LOOP-CONTROL-19.md and candidate manifest; independent review is still required.

alternatives: Leave stages connected only by prompts: rejected because durable diagnosis and acceptance remain ambiguous.
Create a second runtime or truth graph: rejected because it duplicates ADR-010, CP-01–06 and module ownership.
Integrate closed-loop semantics into existing modules and task contributions: proposed; reuse current invariants.

impact.ux: Extend SC-02/03/06/07/08/09/10/11/24 with selective questions, proof gaps, diagnostic routes and distinct outcome states; preserve keyboard/form/diagram parity.
impact.model: Add versioned intent, uncertainty, evaluation and reconciliation payloads over canonical aggregates; applicability is distinct from existing truth states.
impact.apiEvents: Register scoped commands through CP-01; bind expected heads, idempotency and causal events; precise transport examples follow in bounded packets.
impact.security: Keep current Warden/Arbiter authority, independent reviews and tenant filtering; no evaluator/answer may mint authority. Protect holdouts, evidence and evaluator context.
impact.workflow: Use ADR-010 interpreter and bounded feedback iterations; atomic domain receipts/outbox, model-independent resume and no-progress budgets; active runs stay pinned.
impact.migration: Legacy statuses remain unverified; additive schemas and resumable backfill require lineage checks. Unknown effects prohibit unsafe active-run migration.
impact.evidence: Bind results to contract/evaluator/input/target versions; keep pass/fail/indeterminate/error; calibration and observation windows required; stale results stay historical.
impact.operations: Measure diagnostic routes, useful questions, loop exhaustion and accepted outcomes; restore fences domain/runtime/provider histories; no paid or billing fallback.
impact.dependencies: 18 slice dependencies supplement unchanged parent graph; T-01 supplies schemas without requiring downstream runtime completion. Affected packets bind this candidate; unrelated T-02 remains independent.
impact.qualification: Add 24 CL and four supplementary cases to T-132 without replacing 480 original AC, WF16, SQ/PQ/source requirements or changing P12/E16. All product runs not_run.

invalidationPlan: All affected candidate packets must incorporate the CL overlay before approval; current registry has zero approved packets.
Any candidate artifact hash change invalidates its review and closedLoopCandidateDigest linkage.

resumeCondition: Independent architecture/security review of exact candidate manifest, then governed approval/adoption and bounded T-01 CL-001/002 schema/seed/observation packet integration. Product implementation and automatic model dispatch are not authorized by structural validation.
